messages:
raj_ops: Kicking off handoff for the new "kona" GPU cluster in ap-northeast-3. Summary: 12x A100 nodes provisioned, 2 reserved for system services, autoscaler enabled (min=2, max=10), network routes through peering-vpc-02. Need SRE/on-call ownership and paging config confirmed.

maria_sre: thanks — quick checklist question: did infra set up the cross-region NAT gateway and the egress firewall rules for telemetry?

kevin_infra: yes — NAT and SNAT rules applied. Blocked all inbound except ssh from bastion and prometheus scrape ip. Egress allowed to: metrics.redwood.com, s3.redwood-data, kms.redwood-sec. I dropped the netpol snippet in the runbook link.

raj_ops: runbook link (canonical): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kona-bootstrap — contains: bootstrap steps, validation scripts, kubelet flags, driver install, and cost estimates. Please confirm you read the "paging" section.

kevin_infra: confirmed. Driver install used GPU Operator v1.10 and our patched nvidia-container-runtime. CUDA images are pinned to 11.8.

deploy-bot: Deployment event: cluster/kona created by kevin_infra at 2026-02-28T21:02:46Z.

maria_sre: Paging config notes I updated in-runbook: Prometheus alert names and thresholds (please review):
```
- Alert: KONA_GPU_NodeNotReady
  expr: kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",job="kube-state-metrics",cluster="kona"} == 0
  for: 2m
- Alert: KONA_GPU_MemoryPressure
  expr: node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes < 0.08
  for: 5m
- Alert: KONA_GPU_PodOOMRate
  expr: increase(container_oom_events_total{cluster="kona"}[15m]) > 0
  for: 0m
```

maria_sre: PagerDuty service: pd-service-kona-gpu. Escalation: 0-5m -> on-call primary (tess_oncall), 5-20m -> infra lead (kevin_infra), 20-60m -> eng-sre pager rota, 60m+ -> exec ops. Opsgenie / PagerDuty keys are stored in vault path: secret/data/oncall/kona.

tess_oncall: acked. I added a quick responder checklist to the runbook for first-responders. Key items: verify node health via `kubectl get nodes -o wide --selector=redwood.k8s/gpu=true`, check `nvidia-smi` on node, validate driver pod status `kubectl -n gpu-operator get pods`. Also included common remediation commands.

raj_ops: cost guardrails: cluster has a soft budget of $4k/month for the pilot. Autoscaler configured to prefer spot but will fallback to on-demand after 3m of unfulfilled capacity. Alert: KONA_Spend_Provisional if spend > $1k in rolling 7-day window (alerts to finance-ops channel).

kevin_infra: networking caveat: we observed asymmetric MTU on peered network during validation — caused transient grpc failures for model shards. Workaround: set kube-proxy conntrack max to 131072 and bump MTU on eni to 8950. Logged as infra ticket INF-3246.

maria_sre: Training and runbook handover: I've scheduled a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow 9am PT for the on-call team; invite sent to eng-oncall + infra. Recording will be attached to the runbook.

raj_ops: Ownership: for the first 30 days, SRE owns paging and incident response for kona. After 30 days we'll evaluate moving to regional infra ownership. Page flow: PagerDuty -> primary on-call (tess_oncall) -> infra lead (kevin_infra) -> eng-sre escalation. If primary is unreachable, PD auto-escalates to infra lead at 5m.

tess_oncall: Quick question — any special log aggregation tags to look for?

kevin_infra: yes: set tag `cluster:kona`, `region:ap-northeast-3`, `nodepool:gpu-a100`. GPU driver logs forwarded to `logs.gpu-drivers` index. Promtail config snippet is in the runbook.

maria_sre: small change: for NodeNotReady we shortened `for` to 2m because of fast autoscaler reactions; however, for OOM alerts we keep 0m so we page instantly. We should avoid alert storms: use PD suppressions for maintenance windows (bootstrap and node image rollouts).

raj_ops: final checks before handoff: 1) confirm PD service has working webhook -> incident channel, 2) confirm vault secrets are accessible by on-call, 3) attach runbook + validation logs to PD service, 4) confirm the autoscaler behavior in staging smoke tests.

pagerbot: PagerDuty test notification: pd-service-kona-gpu -> primary (tess_oncall) delivered at 2026-02-28T21:08:12Z (ACK pending).

tess_oncall: acked the test. All good from on-call side. I'll be primary for the next 24h for the pilot.

raj_ops: thanks everyone — handing off. Please file any follow-ups in #eng-oncall or attach to the runbook page. Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
